goal: RC21: Improve conditional prediction quality to pass S2/S7/S8. Target 7+/9 suites.
scope: Level C — Mean head addition, encoder loss modifications, conditioning changes. Keep base decoder + barrier.

constraints.must_generalize: Any conditional scenario generation (IV, rates, FX, credit)
constraints.eval_both_checkpoints: ALWAYS evaluate BOTH best and final — val loss is unreliable
constraints.composite_checkpoint_selection: Track regime-conditioned mean bias, encoder linear probe accuracy, pooled KS-levels

metric: v2 suite >= 7/9 AND S2 worst_cell_coverage > 0.70 AND S7 L2 >= 6/8
